; Skinning on VU1 - the blend pass, two corners per loop iteration.
; GENERATED by tools/vu1-skin-schedule.py --program from skin_vu1_blend_sketch.vsm.txt:
; do not edit by hand. Not linked into the engine (the .txt suffix keeps it out of the
; build); the assembled size and the cycle figures are in docs/animated-models.md.
;
; Batch buffer (qwords): 0 header (x = corner pairs in the batch), then per corner six
; qwords: 0 bind index (int16 x y z, w = 1), 1 ST, 2 colour, 3 bind normal (int8 x127),
; 4 joint offsets (pre-scaled palette qwords), 5 raw weights. The blend overwrites qwords
; 0 and 3 with the blended index and normal; the tail that follows reads them.
; qword 22 holds the constant 127 in x (written by the EE with the palette sides).

.syntax new
.name StaPipVU1SkinBlendPass
.vu
.init_vf_all
.init_vi_all

--enter
--endenter

#vuprog StaPipVU1SkinBlendPass

    lq         vf31, 22(vi00)         ; the renormalise numerator, x = 127
begin:
    xtop       vi13                   ; the batch buffer
    ilw.w      vi14, 0(vi13)          ; corner pairs in this batch
    iaddiu     vi1, vi13, 2           ; corner A: the first corner after the header
    iaddiu     vi2, vi13, 8           ; corner B: six qwords on
loop:
    ; cycle 0
    lq vf1, 0(vi1)
    ; cycle 1
    lq vf2, 3(vi1)
    ; cycle 2
    lq vf3, 5(vi1)
    ; cycle 3
    ilw.x vi3, 4(vi1)
    ; cycle 4
    ilw.y vi4, 4(vi1)
    itof0 vf1, vf1
    ; cycle 5
    ilw.z vi5, 4(vi1)
    itof0 vf2, vf2
    ; cycle 6
    ilw.w vi6, 4(vi1)
    itof0 vf3, vf3
    ; cycle 7
    lq vf4, 0(vi3)
    ; cycle 8
    lq vf5, 1(vi3)
    ; cycle 9
    lq vf6, 2(vi3)
    ; cycle 10
    lq vf7, 3(vi3)
    ; cycle 11
    lq vf8, 0(vi4)
    mula acc, vf4, vf1[x]
    ; cycle 12
    lq vf9, 1(vi4)
    ; cycle 13
    lq vf10, 2(vi4)
    ; cycle 14
    lq vf11, 3(vi4)
    ; cycle 15
    lq vf12, 0(vi5)
    madda acc, vf5, vf1[y]
    ; cycle 16
    lq vf13, 1(vi5)
    ; cycle 17
    lq vf14, 2(vi5)
    ; cycle 18
    lq vf15, 3(vi5)
    ; cycle 19
    lq vf16, 0(vi6)
    madda acc, vf6, vf1[z]
    ; cycle 20
    lq vf17, 1(vi6)
    ; cycle 21
    lq vf18, 2(vi6)
    ; cycle 22
    lq vf19, 3(vi6)
    ; cycle 23

    ; cycle 24
    lq vf22, 3(vi2)
    mula acc, vf4, vf2[x]
    ; cycle 25
    lq vf23, 5(vi2)
    ; cycle 26
    ilw.x vi7, 4(vi2)
    ; cycle 27
    ilw.y vi8, 4(vi2)
    mul vf24, vf20, vf3[x]
    ; cycle 28
    ilw.z vi9, 4(vi2)
    madda acc, vf5, vf2[y]
    ; cycle 29
    ilw.w vi10, 4(vi2)
    itof0 vf21, vf21
    ; cycle 30
    lq vf25, 0(vi7)
    itof0 vf22, vf22
    ; cycle 31
    lq vf26, 1(vi7)
    itof0 vf23, vf23
    ; cycle 32
    lq vf28, 2(vi7)
    madd vf27, vf6, vf2[z]
    ; cycle 33
    lq vf29, 3(vi7)
    mula acc, vf8, vf1[x]
    ; cycle 34
    lq vf30, 0(vi8)

    ; cycle 36

    ; cycle 37

    ; cycle 39

    ; cycle 41

    ; cycle 42

    ; cycle 46

    sq vf24, 0(vi1)

    ; cycle 106
    add vf4, vf4, vf13
    ; cycle 108
    mul vf19, vf1, vf23[z]

    madda acc, vf26, vf21[y]

    mul vf12, vf4, vf4

    ; cycle 119
    mula acc, vf9, vf22[x]

    mul vf16, vf14, vf23[w]
    ; cycle 122
    rsqrt q, vf31[x], vf12[x]

    madda acc, vf26, vf22[y]
    ; cycle 125
    add vf29, vf29, vf16

    ; cycle 135
    add vf28, vf28, vf17
    ; cycle 138
    ftoi0 vf25, vf25
    ; cycle 139
    mul vf2, vf28, vf28
    ; cycle 142
    sq vf25, 3(vi1)
    ; cycle 143
    add.x vf2, vf2, vf2[y]
    ; cycle 147
    add.x vf2, vf2, vf2[z]
    ; cycle 151
    rsqrt q, vf31[x], vf2[x]
    ; cycle 163
    mul.xyz vf18, vf28, q
    ; cycle 167
    ftoi0 vf18, vf18
    ; cycle 171
    sq vf18, 3(vi2)
    iaddiu     vi1, vi1, 12           ; the next pair: two corners of six qwords
    iaddiu     vi2, vi2, 12
    iaddi      vi14, vi14, -1         ; the pair count
    ibne       vi14, vi00, loop

    b          begin
